books.title: Original Love
books.author: Henry Shukman
books.description: Henry Shukman's guide to meditation, built around four stages he calls 'inns', moving from mindful attention and support through absorption to awakening. Mixing teaching with stories from his own life and from his students, it puts love, rather than original sin, at the root of human life and of spiritual practice.

books.title: One Blade of Grass
books.author: Henry Shukman
books.description: Henry Shukman's memoir of a life shaped by Zen, from a sudden awakening as a young man and the unsettled years after it to long training with Zen teachers. Written with a poet's ear, it makes Zen practice and its insights clear to general readers.
